notes.title: Clarification about short DEMO
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Andrea here, aka "silver978".

Thanks to who already played the demo and gave us some feedbacks.

I am aware that the demo is extremely short, but, unfortunately, the full game is a "short game", so I couldn't do a longer demo without spoiling half of the final experience.

This is our first project and also a method to know if we can dedicate full time on game development.
If the main vibe of the game is understood by the players, this is one big step for me already.

If you're still interested in the full game and want to give it a chance at the release, I will be glad to hear your feedback on the complete experience.

Thank you,
Andrea
